أسلنقي (form IIIq)
# أَسْلَنْقِي (ʔaslanqī) /ʔas.lan.qiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْلَنْقَى (islanqā)
# أَسْلَنْقِيَ (ʔaslanqiya) /ʔas.lan.qi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْلَنْقَى (islanqā)
